entity.scope: Sponsor-wide finances are not PHC program costs

amountSemantics: modeled marginal donor expenditure, not a verified funding offer

judgments.label: Donor dollars per completed dispense
judgments.basis: $100 doubles PHC's current $50-per-pair fundraising benchmark to allow delivery, navigation and overhead. Neither amount is an audited marginal program cost. Includes unsuccessful referral effort allocated across completed dispenses; excludes resources financed elsewhere.

judgments.label: Utility gained while effectively corrected
judgments.basis: 0.0375 halves the uncontrolled Zambia six-month EQ-5D improvement of 0.075 for confounding and population/severity transfer. This discount is subjective, not an estimated causal adjustment.

judgments.label: Effective retained-use years
judgments.basis: 0.75 assumes nine useful months within a one-year horizon, incorporating breakage, loss and nonuse. No separate multiyear persistence or discount is credited. Local duration is unmeasured.

judgments.label: Benefit additional to existing access and funding
judgments.basis: 50% is a joint subjective allowance for donations replacing funding and recipients obtaining correction otherwise. Medi-Cal coverage does not guarantee access, but existing coverage cannot be ignored.

nullBoundary: If a gift adds no dispenses or only replaces otherwise available correction, additionality is zero: no finite price per QALY. Positive scenarios are not confidence intervals.

fundingRoom.nextEvidence: Program-level cash, reimbursement and in-kind costs; additional funded dispenses; corrected acuity and usable-glasses follow-up at 3, 6 and 12 months. No organization contact has been made.

excluded: Separate depression or safety benefits that could overlap health utility
Cataract treatment, hearing aids and dentures
Costs covered by insurers, donated professional time and other non-donor resources
